leadership.name: Rev. Elijah Mwangi
leadership.bio: Rev. Elijah Mwangi is the Lead Pastor at Life Celebration Centre of Deliverance Church International, Nakuru. With a deep passion for planting and strengthening churches, he has raised and equipped leaders locally and internationally through preaching, teaching and intentional discipleship.
leadership.bio_more: He holds a Master’s Degree in Theology from Beacon University College of Ministry (USA), a Master’s Degree in Urban and Regional Planning from the University of Nairobi, and a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from Egerton University. He is also an author whose writings focus on biblical truth, leadership development and the Great Commission. He is married to Mary Wambui Maina.

ministries.name: Praise & Worship
ministries.text: LCC’s worship ministers lead the church in praise every Sunday and at Praise Express services. Their recordings — from “Adonai” to “U Mwema” — are shared on our YouTube channel.

ministries.name: Youth & Students
ministries.text: Worship nights for young people, and InterVarsity Worship Experiences that bring university students together for worship and fellowship.

ministries.name: Prayer
ministries.text: Nights of prayer and worship — including the annual Crossover Kesha — and private prayer support from the pastoral team.

ministries.name: Leadership Development
ministries.text: Leaders' Summits that equip, empower and inspire leaders to serve with excellence, wisdom and purpose.

ministries.name: Fellowship
ministries.text: Moments beyond the service filled with love, laughter, fellowship and beautiful connections.

ministries.text: Our annual conference to equip the saints for the work of the ministry.

about.intro: Life Celebration Centre (LCC) is a congregation of Deliverance Church International on General Kariba Street in Freehold, Nakuru. Led by Rev. Elijah Mwangi, LCC gathers every Sunday for two services, streams its worship online, and hosts the annual Cutting Edge Conference for believers from Nakuru and beyond.
about.family: Beyond the Sunday service, LCC makes room for connection time — moments of fellowship, laughter and friendship that turn a congregation into a family.

timeline.title: Cutting Edge Conference begins
timeline.text: LCC hosts the first Cutting Edge Conference, built on Ephesians 4:12: “equipping the saints for the work of the ministry.”

timeline.title: A pause, not an end
timeline.text: The conference was not held for three years because of COVID-19 restrictions on gatherings.

timeline.title: Cutting Edge Conference 2024
timeline.text: Rev. Elijah Mwangi opens the conference; sessions are streamed on the LCC YouTube channel.

timeline.title: InterVarsity Worship Experience
timeline.text: University students gather at LCC for nights of worship and fellowship.

timeline.title: Crossover Kesha
timeline.text: The church crosses into 2026 together in an all-night service of worship and prayer.

timeline.title: 6th Cutting Edge Conference
timeline.text: Six days of evangelism, teaching and preaching — the sixth edition since 2018.

timeline.title: Leaders' Summit
timeline.text: Leaders gather to be equipped and inspired, with guest speaker Bishop Jimmy Kimani.

timeline.title: Cutting Edge Conference 2027
timeline.text: “Commissioning for the Global Mission” — anchor scripture John 4:35.
